purpose: Place cases, entities, concepts, artifacts and dossiers inside nested Rooms without promoting each object into a Room or changing canonical ownership.
rules: Rooms are bounded contexts; inhabitants are contents viewed from that context.
An inhabitant may appear in more than one Room as a projection when different questions are being asked.
Repeated appearance does not create duplicate factual ownership.
Sensitive labels remain typed as project term, attributed classification, legal status, or documented entity role.
Entering an inhabitant centers the case informationally while the containing Room remains architecturally visible.

inhabitants.label: 4chan
inhabitants.summary: Anonymous imageboard infrastructure that helped normalize fast, ephemeral, board-local meme and subculture production.
inhabitants.status_note: Platform identity is not equivalent to the ideology or conduct of every board or user.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Treat platform history, board culture and individual conduct as separate evidence layers.

inhabitants.label: Reddit
inhabitants.summary: Large-scale community platform where subcultures can become durable, searchable and monetizable through ranked discussion and advertising.
inhabitants.status_note: A subreddit is not Reddit as a whole; community moderation and platform governance operate at different levels.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Separate platform revenue and policy from the conduct of a specific community.

inhabitants.label: 8chan / 8kun
inhabitants.summary: User-created imageboard ecology associated with migration from stricter moderation elsewhere and later 8kun continuity.
inhabitants.status_note: Documented platform use by violent actors does not by itself establish monocausal responsibility for violence.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Preserve the distinction between transmission channel, community norm, individual actor and causal finding.

inhabitants.label: Kiwi Farms / persistent target ecology
inhabitants.summary: Persistent target-thread and archive ecology useful for studying long-duration attention, inherited lore, collaborative narrative escalation and infrastructure resilience.
inhabitants.status_note: Do not convert reporting associations, community conduct or civil allegations into broader criminal conclusions without case-specific evidence.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Track target-by-target conduct, chronology, infrastructure, monetization, legal status and causal level separately.

inhabitants.label: Sektur
inhabitants.summary: Project term for a semi-bounded social territory where recurring roles, lore, conflict and attention relations become self-reproducing.
inhabitants.status_note: A Sektur is an analytical project category, not a legal or clinical classification.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Use observable recurrence, roles, boundaries and memory to justify the mapping.

inhabitants.label: Farm / attention loop
inhabitants.summary: Project process model for turning people, events or categories into repeatable attention yield through observation, capture, interpretation, archive and redistribution.
inhabitants.status_note: Farm describes a process, not proof of one coordinated organization or paid campaign.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Identify the actual loop, actors, incentives and captured value before applying the term.

inhabitants.label: Swamp regime
inhabitants.summary: Project regime for conditions where opacity, extraction, blocked correction, role-lock and unresolved residue reinforce recurrence.
inhabitants.status_note: Swamp is not synonymous with government, media, politics, Below, or one conspiracy.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Show which Swamp-pressure mechanisms are present rather than applying the label by dislike.

inhabitants.label: DARVO response pattern
inhabitants.summary: Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim and Offender: a response pattern studied in interpersonal and institutional conflict.
inhabitants.status_note: A denial or counteraccusation is not automatically DARVO, and DARVO language does not prove the original allegation.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Code the sequence of responses and compare it with the claimed pattern.

inhabitants.label: SPLC classification interface
inhabitants.summary: Private nonprofit watchdog/classifier whose outputs can enter media, employer, donor and political consequence chains.
inhabitants.status_note: SPLC classification is not a criminal judgment; current litigation or prosecution concerning the organization does not automatically invalidate every historical classification.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Store classification date, methodology, wording, correction history and downstream use separately.

inhabitants.label: ADL classification interface
inhabitants.summary: Private watchdog/classifier whose extremism research, incident datasets and symbol resources influence public and institutional understanding.
inhabitants.status_note: Incident mapping, symbol classification and organization classification are distinct data types.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Carry methodology and counting rules with every classification or incident claim.

inhabitants.label: FBI / federal law-enforcement interface
inhabitants.summary: Federal law-enforcement interface for criminal investigation, civil-rights enforcement and hate-crime data collection.
inhabitants.status_note: The FBI investigates crimes under statutory authority; being discussed by or reported to the FBI is not proof of guilt.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Separate complaint, investigation, charge, conviction and aggregate statistics.

inhabitants.label: Source ledger
inhabitants.summary: Evidence object that preserves provenance, source authority, claim status and routes back from synthesis to source-bearing material.
inhabitants.status_note: A ledger records support and uncertainty; inclusion is not endorsement of the claim.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Every promoted claim should be traceable to source identity, date and evidence class.

inhabitants.label: Chronology / attestation chain
inhabitants.summary: Chronology object for separating occurrence time, attestation time, publication time and later interpretation.
inhabitants.status_note: Temporal sequence can support priority or chronology without proving causation.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Keep date precision and source precision explicit.

inhabitants.label: Forge review
inhabitants.summary: Project review process for separating source, claim, evidence, mechanism, legal/status class, counterevidence and repair before promotion.
inhabitants.status_note: Forge is a process projected spatially, not a literal room that owns all knowledge.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Outputs may be verified, narrowed, rejected, repaired or left unresolved.

inhabitants.label: Bible Atlas / Comparator
inhabitants.summary: Reader-facing biblical corpus and comparison surface for stories, roles, symbols, actions, books and timeline relations.
inhabitants.status_note: Scripture, historical interpretation and project comparison remain separate evidence classes.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Comparison should begin from the biblical text and preserve source context before project mapping.

inhabitants.label: Thomas / Didymus tradition
inhabitants.summary: Canonical and later Thomasine material used to study Twin/Didymus motifs, recognition, doubt and later Syriac traditions.
inhabitants.status_note: John calls Thomas Didymus; later twin traditions are historical traditions, not proof of a modern identity claim.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Keep canonical wording, later textual tradition and project interpretation chronologically separated.

inhabitants.label: Potato tuber
inhabitants.summary: Living storage organ with eyes/nodes, vascular tissue, hormonal control, sprouting and environmental response.
inhabitants.status_note: Biological structure can support analogy without proving symbolic or theological claims.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Use plant physiology for empirical claims and label symbolic correspondences separately.

inhabitants.label: Neural signaling
inhabitants.summary: Animal nervous-system signaling used as an empirical reference for body/brain models and bounded symbolic comparison.
inhabitants.status_note: Plant electrical signaling and animal neural signaling are materially different systems.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Avoid treating structural analogy as identity of mechanism.

inhabitants.label: World Map
inhabitants.summary: Spatial public surface for countries, states, institutions, routes and world-system layers.
inhabitants.status_note: Map placement is a visualization of registered data or project alignment, not proof of political control or causal influence.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Each map layer should expose source, date, scope and classification method.

inhabitants.label: Foundation Timeline
inhabitants.summary: Timeline and Room view for foundations, their origin Doors, place, genealogy, reproduction and present state.
inhabitants.status_note: A Foundation may have several clocks; origin, adoption, legal effect and later consolidation should not be collapsed into one birthday.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Record the earliest recovered reproduction separately from the founding threshold.

inhabitants.label: Prediction chronology
inhabitants.summary: Chronology for recording what was said first, when later outcomes occurred, and how closely a later event matches the earlier statement.
inhabitants.status_note: A later match is not automatically proof of prophecy, causation or statistical significance.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Preserve original wording, timestamp, outcome source, lead time and match strength.

inhabitants.label: The Great Book of Potato
inhabitants.summary: Long-form literary and mythic work that gathers project narrative, theology, symbolism, history and creative interpretation.
inhabitants.status_note: Literary canon and external historical fact are distinct layers.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Trace claims back to source-bearing records when the book moves beyond literary interpretation.

inhabitants.label: Music / songs
inhabitants.summary: Creative sound and song output treated as Fruit: an expression that can carry memory, rhythm, humor, doctrine or social commentary.
inhabitants.status_note: Creative expression does not become factual evidence merely because it is canonical or popular.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Track source Rooms, intended effect, reception and future Seed separately.

inhabitants.label: Visual art / diagrams
inhabitants.summary: Images, diagrams and symbolic compositions that make project relationships spatially visible.
inhabitants.status_note: A diagram is a model or artwork unless independently tied to measured geometry.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Label whether an image is illustrative, canonical-symbolic, comparative or empirical.

inhabitants.label: Games / simulations
inhabitants.summary: Interactive models for exploring rules, transitions, incentives and system behavior.
inhabitants.status_note: Simulation behavior depends on model assumptions and is not direct prediction of the real world.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Expose assumptions, parameters, outputs and failure conditions.

inhabitants.label: Open research question
inhabitants.summary: Unresolved question held in the Forge before promotion into a stronger model, claim or programme.
inhabitants.status_note: Open questions are intentionally unresolved and should not be read as established claims.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Each mature question should name a test, evidence need and disconfirming route.

inhabitants.label: Door / Axis Elevator
inhabitants.summary: Recursive spatial projection of the House: global Axis, vertical planes, Dwellings, nested Rooms, wormhole Doors and local recentering.
inhabitants.status_note: The Elevator is a navigation projection over the graph, not a claim that the repository occupies literal impossible physical geometry.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Its topology must derive from governed Room/adjacency registries rather than visual convenience.

inhabitants.label: Below Basin
inhabitants.summary: Round lower-plane vessel projecting Culture, Sektur, Farm, Swamp, Mud/Ash, Roots, Forge and Axis/Drain into one operational spatial model.
inhabitants.status_note: Spatial overlap does not collapse categories: Swamp remains a regime, Farm a process, Mud a material state and Forge a process.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Motion between zones follows the Basin dynamics contract rather than moral or aesthetic assignment.

inhabitants.label: House journey thread
inhabitants.summary: Browser-local path memory that records how a reader moved through Dwellings, Rooms, wormholes, portals, readable surfaces and object focus.
inhabitants.status_note: Journey memory is private navigation state, not analytics, evidence or user profiling.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Recorded path describes the reader's route, not the only valid conceptual route.

inhabitants.label: Room / wormhole graph
inhabitants.summary: Typed graph that lets bounded Rooms remain stable owners while registered adjacencies create local doors and cross-Dwelling wormholes.
inhabitants.status_note: Graph adjacency means modeled relation, not physical proximity or causal control.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Cross-Dwelling doors must come from registered topology/interfaces.

inhabitants.label: Level 3 center table
inhabitants.summary: Inspection surface that centers a case, platform, text, process or artifact while preserving its containing Room and alternate Room lenses.
inhabitants.status_note: An object may become informationally central without becoming a Room, Dwelling or knowledge owner.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Status and evidence boundaries travel with the object across every Room lens.
